title: Unexpected behavior of links to enum values in editor help
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in v4.5.dev.custom_build [2c2c876e3]

### System information

Godot v4.5.dev (2c2c876e3) - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Wed, 14 May 2025 14:56:34 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT (RADV NAVI31) - AMD Ryzen 9 7900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

Enum values can be referenced in doc comments using the `[constant]` tag, however this behavior can be unexpected, and can also lead to links leading to the wrong value.
Here are examples for a class named `MyClass` and an enum named `MyEnum`, with a value `VALUE` (note that for all examples, the editor help formats the text as a link, even when the link doesn't work):
* From `MyClass`:
    *  `[constant MyEnum.VALUE]` doesn't link anywhere
    * `[constant VALUE]` links to the enum value
    * `[constant MyClass.VALUE]` links to the enum value
    * `[constant MyClass.MyEnum.VALUE]` doesn't link anywhere
* From another class, the results are the same, except for `[constant VALUE]`, which is obviously not a valid link.
* If you add a second enum to `MyClass`, let's say `SecondEnum`, which also has a value named `VALUE`, *all* links that previously lead to `MyEnum.VALUE` now lead to `SecondEnum.VALUE`, and named enums still cannot be included in the references to differentiate.

The only way to work around this issue as it stands is to prefix enum values, for instance:
```gdscript
enum MyEnum {ME_VALUE}
enum SecondEnum {SE_VALUE}
```
and use the corresponding `[constant ME_VALUE]` or `[constant MyClass.ME_VALUE]` references.

### Steps to reproduce

```gdscript
enum MyEnum {VALUE}

## [constant MyEnum.VALUE] + the other examples listed above, or see MRP for more
var my_var := MyEnum.VALUE
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[enum-link-behavior.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20478049/enum-link-behavior.zip)

This project contains a single class named EnumLinkBehavior, with 2 named enums and multiple variations of `[constant *]` references in doc comments. Several links are not working, while all working links point to the second enum.
